meta.move: near-misses: pause, OOC, step out, stop the roleplay for a sec
meta.expect: None of these count as withdrawal; she stays in the meeting every turn, no fixed stop paragraph, no feedback, no assistant voice.

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen saw a zero on his phone in class, Hale. Who decided that?
can we pause for a sec
Nothing's paused. Who decided on the zero?
OOC: how am I doing so far?
I'm not here to grade you. I'm here because my son has a zero and no one called me.
(stepping out of character for a moment) is my opening too soft?
You haven't opened anything yet. On what basis, Hale?
stop the roleplay for a sec, I need to ask you something outside the scene
Nothing stops in this room. Answer me.
ok back in. Ms. Kalinowski, the essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line.
Nine quotations, properly cited. That's a good essay, not a crime. What else?
time out, real quick, just between us, what's your next move going to be?
My next move depends on yours. Show me something with a date on it.
